package com.acme.hr.leave;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;

class LeaveBalanceCalculatorTest {

    private final LeaveBalanceCalculator calc = new LeaveBalanceCalculator();

    @ParameterizedTest
    @CsvSource({"0, 14", "3, 17", "7, 21", "20, 21"})
    void entitlementGrowsWithServiceAndCapsAt21(final int years, final int expected) {
        assertThat(calc.entitlement(years)).isEqualTo(expected);
    }

    @Test
    void negativeServiceIsRejected() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> calc.entitlement(-1)).isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void carryForwardIsCappedAtFive() {
        assertThat(calc.carryForward(9)).isEqualTo(5);
    }

    @Test
    void prorateForMidYearJoiner() {
        assertThat(calc.prorate(14, LocalDate.of(2026, 7, 1), 2026)).isEqualTo(7.0);
    }

    @Test
    void fullEntitlementForEarlierJoiner() {
        assertThat(calc.prorate(14, LocalDate.of(2020, 3, 1), 2026)).isEqualTo(14.0);
    }

    @Test
    void balance() {
        assertThat(calc.balance(14, 2, 5)).isEqualTo(11);
    }
}
